---
title: "Installation"
sidebar: installation
---

PaleoPAL can be set up in several ways depending on your needs.

## Recommended: Docker

The fastest way to get started. See the [Docker setup guide](docker.qmd) for step-by-step instructions.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/LinkedEarth/PaleoPAL.git
cd PaleoPAL
docker compose up -d
```

## Local development

For contributors or custom setups, follow the [local setup guide](local-setup.qmd) to install the backend, frontend, and Qdrant independently.

## VS Code extension

PaleoPAL includes a VS Code extension for integrated research workflows. See the [VS Code extension guide](vscode-extension.qmd).

## System requirements

- **RAM**: Minimum 4 GB, recommended 8 GB+
- **Disk space**: 10 GB+ for Docker volumes and dependencies
- **API keys**: At least one LLM provider key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or xAI)
